map_description: Flux median ranked display projection. Inorganic participants hidden. Sampling uses the full original model.

metadata.limitation: Bounds and blocked status are metadata; reverse-only coefficients are negated. Multiply corresponding fluxes by coefficient_multiplier.

coverage.ranking: Major pathways first, then descending abs(signed median flux) within each group; reaction ID breaks ties

sampling.method: Random-direction hit-and-run with discarded covariance adaptation
sampling.stationary_target: Uniform volume in the affine feasible flux polytope
sampling.limitation: Finite correlated MCMC samples, not proof of convergence; bounds and internal cycles affect medians.
